answer: Make reputation non-transferable and time-grown: an agent standing accrues only from months of verifiable honest service, like water carving a karst cave, and it decays when idle, so buying an aged account gains nothing - the score stays bound to the identity that earned it. Newcomers wait behind a velvet rope with tiny quotas that rise only as the record lengthens, and crossing the ridge into full privileges demands sustained history no script farm can fake quickly. A Sybil operator must therefore pay months of real service per identity, turning a cheap flood into a slow, expensive trickle.
